Generate rank file for GSEA

Source: R/process_rnaseq.R
generate_de_rank_file.Rd

Ranks the genes of a DE table by their pi-value (see rank_de_genes) and returns, and optionally writes, the two-column table read by the GSEA desktop application (`.rnk`). For fgsea, use `setNames(rnk$rank, rnk$GeneName)`.

Usage

generate_de_rank_file(
  data,
  file = NULL,
  method = c("auto", "edgeR", "DESeq2", "limma", "seurat"),
  padj.col = NULL,
  logfc.col = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

data

A data frame of DE results with a log2 fold change and an adjusted p-value column (edgeR, DESeq2, limma or Seurat results, or any table with the columns given)

file

Path of the tab-separated rank file to write. Default is NULL (nothing written)

method

The tool that produced the results: "auto" (default) detects it from the column names, as standardize_de does; or one of "edgeR", "DESeq2", "limma" and "seurat"

padj.col

Column of the (adjusted) p-values used for the ranking. If NULL (default), taken from `method` (e.g. "FDR" for edgeR, "padj" for DESeq2)

logfc.col

Column of the log2 fold changes. If NULL (default), taken from `method`

...

Deprecated names of the arguments (`de_results`, `save_file`, `de_method`, `pvalue_col`, `log2fc_col`), accepted with a warning; renamed in 0.10.0

Value

A data frame with columns `GeneName` (the row names of `data`) and `rank` (the pi-value), from highest to lowest; written to `file` when given
